analyticalQuestion: Can a strain-only pullback control physical normalized covariance when the signed strain integral and pulled residual both vanish?
takeaway: No. Time ordering creates hyperbolic holonomy from a zero-signed-integral strain loop, while Euclidean residual sensitivity has a sharp kappa_2(G)^2 loss and the affine-relative escape is unavailable at covariance rank loss.
